title: Craft a Disk
description: This data pack adds a crafting recipe too almost every disc.
body: ### # ### - ### # ## This data pack adds **custom crafting recipes** to **every** music disc! Dont play to loot 45 structers to find one disc, craft them instead. With _proper crafts that resemble the discs textures and hinting with blocks and items of where they would have been found!_
